<thought>From the 13C NMR data, the chemical shifts in the typical aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm) are: 160.80, 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, and 124.85 ppm. That corresponds to seven distinct aromatic carbon signals, indicating seven aromatic carbons in the molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>7</final_answer>
